SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT b.board_sq AS sq, b.board_ttl AS ttl, b.board_description_edt AS description, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nm AS userNm, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, b.board_type_cd AS boardTypeCd, b.board_category_cd AS boardCategoryCd FROM TBL_BOARD_M b JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON b.user_sq = u.user_sq WHERE b.board_is_deleted_yn = 'N' AND b.board_type_cd IN (1401, 1402) UNION ALL SELECT a.answer_sq AS sq, a.answer_ttl AS ttl, a.answer_description_edt AS description, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nm AS userNm, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, 1499 AS boardTypeCd, NULL AS boardCategoryCd FROM TBL_BOARD_ANSWER_S a JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON a.user_sq = u.user_sq
JOIN TBL_BOARD_M pb ON pb.board_sq = a.board_sq AND pb.board_type_cd IN (1401, 1402) WHERE a.answer_is_deleted_yn = 'N' ) AS unified WHERE 1=1 AND boardTypeCd IN #{t}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_BOARD_M SET board_is_deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE board_sq = #{sq}
UPDATE TBL_BOARD_ANSWER_S SET answer_is_deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE answer_sq = #{sq}
UPDATE TBL_BOARD_COMMENT_S SET comment_is_deleted_yn = 'Y', comment_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE comment_sq = #{commentSq}
